from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
import re

# login tokens (reuse if already exist?)
sup_pw={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=sup_pw['venmo'])['access_token']
simple_note_token=apis.simple_note.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=sup_pw['simple_note'])['access_token']
phone_token=apis.phone.login(username='7826309761', password=sup_pw['phone'])['access_token']

# find all notes with 'Work Dinner' in title/content using search query
all_notes=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    page=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_note_token, query='Work Dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    all_notes.extend(page)
    page_index+=1

# choose candidate notes that look like dinner share sheets (have 'What I paid for whom' in content)
# We'll inspect content of each candidate note_id from search results.
candidates=[]
for n in all_notes:
    note_id=n['note_id']
    title=n.get('title','')
    if 'Work Dinner' in title:
        note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
        content=note.get('content','')
        if 'What I paid for whom' in content:
            candidates.append(note)

print('candidate work dinner share notes:',[(n['note_id'], n['title'], n.get('updated_at')) for n in candidates])
# pick most recently updated
chosen=max(candidates, key=lambda x: x.get('updated_at',''))
print('chosen note:',chosen['note_id'],chosen['title'],chosen.get('updated_at'))

# parse shares
shares={}
for line in chosen['content'].splitlines():
    m=re.search(r'-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)', line.strip())
    if m:
        name=m.group(1).strip()
        amt=Decimal(m.group(2))
        shares[name]=shares.get(name, Decimal('0')) + amt

print('due shares:',shares)
print('due total:',sum(shares.values()))

yesterday=(datetime.now()-timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('yesterday_date',yesterday)

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
import re

# Setup tokens
sup_pw={p['account_name']:p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()}
venmo_token=apis.venmo.login(username='cod.smith@gmail.com', password=sup_pw['venmo'])['access_token']

# Due shares from Simple Note 3084
shares = {
    'Kayla': Decimal('20'),
    'Sandra': Decimal('19'),
    'Stephen': Decimal('20'),
    'Jamie': Decimal('15'),
    'Anita': Decimal('23'),
    'Travis': Decimal('39'),
    'Sabrina': Decimal('39'),
}

# Map names to Venmo emails via phone-contact resolution (previously matched)
name_to_email = {
    'Kayla': 'ka_burt@gmail.com',
    'Sandra': 'saritt@gmail.com',
    'Stephen': 'stmcco@gmail.com',
    'Jamie': 'jamie-solomon@gmail.com',
    'Anita': 'anita.burch@gmail.com',
    'Travis': 'tra_wils@gmail.com',
    'Sabrina': 'sab-brown@gmail.com'
}

now=datetime.now()
yesterday=(now-timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
today=now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
print('date window',yesterday,'to',today)

# Check who already paid: sum of received transactions with description containing 'Work Dinner'
# We'll use description exactly equals 'Work Dinner' or includes it.
received_totals = {name: Decimal('0') for name in shares}
received_tx = {name: [] for name in shares}

for name,email in name_to_email.items():
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    txs=[]
    while True:
        page=apis.venmo.show_transactions(
            access_token=venmo_token,
            user_email=email,
            direction='received',
            min_created_at=yesterday,
            max_created_at=today,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        print('tx page',name,'idx',page_index,'len',len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        txs.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    # filter by description
    for t in txs:
        desc=(t.get('description') or '').strip()
        if 'Work Dinner' in desc:
            amt=Decimal(str(t.get('amount')))
            received_totals[name]+=amt
            received_tx[name].append((t['transaction_id'], amt, desc, t.get('created_at')))

    print('received_total',name,received_totals[name],'tx_count_workdinner',len(received_tx[name]))
    if received_tx[name]:
        print('  sample',received_tx[name][:3])

# Determine unpaid
unpaid={name:amt for name,amt in shares.items() if received_totals[name] < amt}
paid={name:amt for name,amt in shares.items() if received_totals[name] >= amt}
print('paid',paid)
print('unpaid',unpaid)
